title: C28x Hardware Interrupt
text: Interrupt Service Routine to handle hardware interrupt on C28x processors, 1 input, 1 output; {CPU interrupt number} sets the vector of CPU interrupt, {PIE interrupt number} sets a vector of PIE interrupt, {Simulink task priorities} sets the provides relative importance of tasks associated with the asynchronous interrupts, {Preemption flags: preemptable-1, non-preemptable-0} sets a vector of preemption flags and {Enable simulation input} enables simulation ports to block. Values come from the instance.

params.name: CPU interrupt number
params.values: Specify vector of CPU interrupt [1 1] (default) | integer in [1, 8]

params.name: PIE interrupt number
params.values: Specify a vector of PIE interrupt [1 2] (default)

params.name: Simulink task priorities
params.values: Provides relative importance of tasks associated with the asynchronous interrupts [30 26] (default)

params.name: Preemption flags: preemptable-1, non-preemptable-0
params.values: Specify a vector of preemption flags for the interrupts 0 0 (default)

params.name: Enable simulation input
params.values: Enable simulation ports to block off (default) | on
